metadata.task: Stage 6M v1.5 Task 7.7.2B — Production Validator Impact Assessment

false_rejection_analysis.qualification: Recordings exhibit complete current-file physical MPEG frames and error-free PCM decoding, with duration shortfall caused by libmpg123 file-size estimation artifact. Classified as POTENTIAL false-rejection candidates rather than PROVEN false rejections because authoritative original recording duration is absent.

false_acceptance_analysis.qualification: Claim A (current file contains structurally complete MPEG frames) does NOT establish Claim B (the original recording was not shortened upstream). Whole-frame truncation at MPEG frame boundaries leaves perfectly valid residual frames. Without an authoritative original duration reference, the risk of undetected upstream whole-frame loss is UNKNOWN and cannot be quantified as low.
